items.claim: In boundary_rationale the sentence on 9:2 carries the tier EXTRACTED OSHB/WLC for the statement that the repeated year formula is texture and opens nothing. The witness holds the formula at 9:2 words 1-3 and the device inventory lists 9:2 among its eight dateline entries; that it opens no unit is a reading, and the same row's device_notes tiers that reading INFERRED. The stronger word stands on the weaker fact.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. Onset 8:27/9:1: behind it 8:27 ends on the splice the row cites (the last two words of the verse) and PE follows 8:27 in the mark layer; ahead, 9:1 opens on the year formula at words 1-2 and is a dateline entry of the inventory. Close 9:3/9:4: no mark stands there; 9:3 and 9:4 both open on first-person narrative verb forms, and the quoted address begins only at 9:4 word 8, so the Masoretic layer gives this edge no support of its own and the row's soft grading of it is right.

suggested_fix.fact: The presence of the year formula at 9:2 is in the witness and in the dateline inventory; that it resumes 9:1 and opens no unit is a reading and takes the weaker tier, as device_notes already has it.

evidence: GRAVEST (tier): the boundary_rationale sentence on 9:2 ends [EXTRACTED OSHB/WLC]; the device_notes sentence on the same reading ends [INFERRED]. oshb:Dan.9.2 words 1-3: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת אַחַת֙ לְמָלְכ֔וֹ ; dan_device_inventory.json datelines verses_mt holds Dan.9.1, Dan.9.2 and Dan.10.1 among its 8.

SECOND (tier and extent): device_notes says verses 9:1-9:3 are first-person narrative [EXTRACTED OSHB/WLC]. I read oshb:Dan.9.1 and found no first-person form in it; the first stands at 9:2 words 4-5 אֲנִי֙ דָּֽנִיֵּ֔אל with the verb at word 6 בִּינֹ֖תִי. The person is in the witness from 9:2; the genre word is the row's reading.

THIRD (gloss extent): three WEB quotations set beside a splice run past it. 9:1 splice = words 1-2 בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת while the quotation also renders words 3-5 לְדָרְיָ֛וֶשׁ בֶּן אֲחַשְׁוֵר֖וֹשׁ ; 9:3 splice = words 1-3 while the quotation also renders words 4-6 אֶל אֲדֹנָי֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים ; 9:4 splice = words 1-2 while the quotation also renders words 3-5 אֱלֹהַ֖י וָאֶתְוַדֶּ֑ה וָאֹֽמְרָ֗ה. Word positions are measured by script; the alignment of English words to Hebrew words is my reading.

SUPPORTED: all 15 Hebrew runs in the row are exact substrings of Dan_oshb.txt at the cited reference (script); the three WEB quotations are verbatim in Dan_web_clean.txt; pmarks marks holds PE at Dan.8.27 and nothing at 9.1-9.26; pmarks kq and paseq hold no entry for 9.1-9.3, and the row claims none; every observed signal (dateline 9.1 and 9.2, i_daniel_heb 9.2, yhwh_name_heb 9.2, set_face_heb 9.3, great_and_awesome_god_heb 9.4) is in the inventory at that verse.
SUPPORTED (syntax, INFERRED): the main clause of the sentence begun at 9:1 arrives at 9:2 word 6, which fits the row's reading of 9:2 as resumptive.
Mark, K/Q and paseq facts are read from the mark layer, WLC (OSHB) only, a single witness.

items.claim: boundary_rationale ends by saying the 11-verse span has no internal formula, mark or dateline, tiered EXTRACTED OSHB/WLC. The mark and dateline parts hold. The formula part does not hold as written: the device inventory's formula family has hits inside the span at 9:7 (the righteousness ascription) and at 9:8, 9:10, 9:13 and 9:14 (the divine name), and the row lists those same hits among its own signals. What the layers support is narrower: no onset-type formula, no mark and no dateline stand inside 9:5-9:14. That sentence carries the row's licence to exceed nine verses.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. Onset 9:3/9:4: no mark; 9:3 is narration, 9:4 opens with the verb of praying and the address stands at words 8-10. Close 9:14/9:15: no mark; 9:14 ends on the splice the row cites (its last three words), and 9:15 opens on the transition particle with a vocative (words 1-3) yet closes on two first-person confession verbs (its last two words חָטָ֖אנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ), so the far side still confesses and the row's soft grading and medium_low confidence fit the bytes.

suggested_fix.fact: Inside 9:4-9:14 the inventory holds formula hits (the righteousness ascription at 9:7; the divine name at 9:8, 9:10, 9:13 and 9:14); none is an onset formula, and no paragraph mark and no dateline stand inside the span.

evidence: GRAVEST: dan_device_inventory.json formulae: to_you_lord_righteousness_heb verses_mt = [Dan.9.7]; yhwh_name_heb verses_mt in chapter 9 = Dan.9.2, 9.4, 9.8, 9.10, 9.13, 9.14, 9.20; great_and_awesome_god_heb = [Dan.9.4]. My own skeleton scan of Dan_oshb.txt for the divine name in chapter 9 returns the same seven verses. The row's observed_substrate_signals lists the 9.7 and the 9.8/9.10/9.13/9.14 hits itself.
The same row's device_notes states the narrower and true form (no internal signal that would open a new unit) with the tier INFERRED.

SUPPORTED (range claims tested against the mark layer): pmarks kq keys inside 9.4-9.14 are exactly Dan.9.5 and Dan.9.12, one note each; pmarks paseq lists Dan.9.12 once and Dan.9.13 once and nothing else in the span; pmarks marks holds nothing for 9.4-9.14.

SUPPORTED: all 16 Hebrew runs in the row are exact substrings at the cited reference; the 9:5 splice is word 1 of the verse and is not the K/Q word (the extract line carries one unpointed word, at position [3]); no quotation binds to a K/Q word at 9:5 or 9:12. The one WEB quotation (9:15) is verbatim and co-extensive with its splice, words 1-3 וְעַתָּ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ.
SUPPORTED: the day-word signal at 9.7 is in the inventory's month_or_day_word_not_a_date list.
Mark, K/Q and paseq facts are read from the mark layer, WLC (OSHB) only, a single witness.

items.claim: Two WEB quotations set beside a Hebrew splice as its rendering cover more than the splice. At 9:17 the splice is words 1-2 while the quotation renders words 1-6, and the English places the vocative before the verb where the Hebrew has it after. At 9:20 the splice is words 1-3 while the quotation renders words 1-5. The 9:15 and 9:19 pairs are co-extensive. Every Hebrew and mark fact in the row is otherwise true on the bytes.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. Onset 9:14/9:15: no mark; behind, 9:14 ends the retrospect on its last three words; ahead, 9:15 opens on the transition particle and vocative but still ends in confession, so the edge is soft from both sides, as the row says. Close 9:19/9:20: no mark; 9:19 ends the address inside quoted speech, and 9:20 opens with a participial circumstantial clause (words 1-3) that 9:21 repeats (words 1-3) before the new subject arrives at 9:21 word 5, so the far side leans back on the prayer; medium_low stands.

suggested_fix.fact: Either the Hebrew cited at 9:17 and 9:20 runs as far as the English quoted beside it, or the English is said to render the whole clause and not only the cited words.

evidence: GRAVEST (gloss extent): oshb:Dan.9.17 splice = words 1-2 וְעַתָּ֣ה שְׁמַ֣ע ; the WEB quotation of 9:17 also renders words 3-6 אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ אֶל תְּפִלַּ֤ת עַבְדְּךָ֙. oshb:Dan.9.20 splice = words 1-3 וְע֨וֹד אֲנִ֤י מְדַבֵּר֙ ; the WEB quotation of 9:20 also renders words 4-5 וּמִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וּמִתְוַדֶּה֙. Word positions are measured by script; the alignment of English words to Hebrew words is my reading.

SUPPORTED (range claims tested against the mark layer): pmarks kq keys inside 9.15-9.19 are exactly Dan.9.18, one note; pmarks paseq lists Dan.9.15 once, Dan.9.17 once, Dan.9.18 twice and Dan.9.19 twice, matching the row's four counts; pmarks marks holds nothing for 9.15-9.19, so no mark stands inside the span or at 9.19/9.20.

SUPPORTED: all 14 Hebrew runs are exact substrings at the cited reference; the splices at 9:15, 9:17, 9:19 and 9:20 each begin at word 1 of their verse; the WEB quotations of 9:15, 9:17, 9:19 and 9:20 are verbatim. No quotation binds to the K/Q word of 9:18.
SUPPORTED: the day-word signal at 9.15 is in the inventory list; the inventory holds no formula hit inside 9.15-9.19, and the row claims none.
SUPPORTED (INFERRED): the rejected rival at 9:16/9:17 is fairly stated; 9:16 already holds a request before the second transition particle at 9:17.
Mark, K/Q and paseq facts are read from the mark layer, WLC (OSHB) only, a single witness.

items.claim: The 9:22 splice and the WEB quotation set beside it do not cover the same words, and the splice is described as opening the messenger's words though it starts one word earlier. The splice is words 3-6 of 9:22; word 3 carries the atnah and closes the narrated clause, the verb of saying is word 4, and the speech proper begins at word 5. The WEB quotation renders words 1-4. So the English covers two words the Hebrew does not show, and the Hebrew shows two words the English does not render.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. Onset 9:19/9:20: no mark; behind, 9:19 ends the quoted prayer; ahead, 9:20 opens on the circumstantial participle clause and 9:21 words 1-3 repeat it, so the onset leans on the prayer. Close 9:23/9:24: no mark; 9:23 ends on a charge addressed to Daniel (its last two words are the splice the row cites) and 9:24 continues the same speaker with a new subject at words 1-2; both edges rest on discourse change alone, as the row states, and medium_low stands.

suggested_fix.fact: At 9:22 the narrated clause ends at word 3 under the atnah, the verb of saying is word 4 and the address to Daniel begins at word 5; the Hebrew cited and the English quoted should cover the same words.

evidence: GRAVEST: oshb:Dan.9.22 words 1-4 (what the WEB quotation renders): וַיָּ֖בֶן וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמִּ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר ; words 3-6 (the row's splice): עִמִּ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר דָּנִיֵּ֕אל עַתָּ֥ה ; word 3 עִמִּ֑י carries U+0591 (checked by script). The splice stands four times in the row (boundary_rationale, strongest_rejected_alternative, one evidence ref, one tag). Word positions are measured by script; the alignment of English words to Hebrew words is my reading.

SECOND (gloss extent, same kind): 9:20 splice = words 1-3, quotation also renders words 4-5; 9:23 splice = the last two words וְהָבֵ֖ן בַּמַּרְאֶֽה while the quotation also renders the two words before them וּבִין֙ בַּדָּבָ֔ר ; 9:24 splice = words 1-2, quotation also renders word 3 נֶחְתַּ֥ךְ.

THIRD (tier): device_notes says the verb of saying at 9:22 is a weak connective and opens no unit, tiered EXTRACTED OSHB/WLC. Its presence is in the witness and in the inventory (and_he_said_heb lists Dan.9.22); that it is weak and opens nothing is a reading.

SUPPORTED (range claim tested): pmarks kq and paseq hold no entry for Dan.9.20-9.23, so the row's statement that no K/Q note and no paseq stand there is true; pmarks marks holds nothing for 9.19-9.26.

SUPPORTED: all 17 Hebrew runs are exact substrings at the cited reference; the five WEB quotations (9:20, 9:21, 9:22, 9:23, 9:24) are verbatim; the signals yhwh_name_heb 9.20, i_saw_heb 9.21, vision_noun_hazon_heb 9.21, and_he_said_heb 9.22 and vision_noun_mareh_heb 9.23 are all in the inventory at those verses; 9:24 is a K/Q verse in the mark layer.
Mark, K/Q and paseq facts are read from the mark layer, WLC (OSHB) only, a single witness.

items.claim: Two WEB quotations set beside a Hebrew splice run past it. At 9:24 the splice is words 1-2 and the quotation also renders word 3, the verb. At 10:1 the splice is words 1-3 and the quotation also renders words 4-5, the royal title. Every Hebrew, mark, K/Q and paseq fact in the row is otherwise true on the bytes, and the Masoretic layer supports the close where the row puts it.
items.both_sides: No cut is proposed. Onset 9:23/9:24: no mark; behind, 9:23 ends the preface on a charge to Daniel; ahead, 9:24 opens with a new subject in the same speaker's mouth, so the edge is unmarked and one-sided, as the row says. Close 9:27/10:1: inside, 9:27 ends on the splice the row cites (its last three words) and PE follows 9:27 in the mark layer; across, 10:1 opens on a year formula that the inventory lists as a dateline. With 8:27/9:1 this is one of the two edges of the cluster that the Masoretic layer marks.

suggested_fix.fact: Either the Hebrew cited at 9:24 and 10:1 runs as far as the English quoted beside it (through the verb at 9:24 word 3 and the title at 10:1 words 4-5), or the English is said to render more than the cited words.

evidence: GRAVEST (gloss extent): oshb:Dan.9.24 splice = words 1-2 שָׁבֻעִ֨ים שִׁבְעִ֜ים ; the quotation also renders word 3 נֶחְתַּ֥ךְ. oshb:Dan.10.1 splice = words 1-3 בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ ; the quotation also renders words 4-5 מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס. Word positions are measured by script; the alignment of English words to Hebrew words is my reading.

SUPPORTED (mark layer, both directions): pmarks marks holds PE at Dan.9.27 and nothing at 9.24-9.26; pmarks kq holds two notes at Dan.9.24 and no other key in 9.24-9.27; pmarks paseq lists Dan.9.24 once and Dan.9.27 once and nothing at 9.25-9.26. Each matches the row.

SUPPORTED: all 10 Hebrew runs are exact substrings at the cited reference; the 9:24 splice is neither K/Q word (the extract line carries unpointed words at positions [11, 12]); the 9:27 splice is the end of the verse; the WEB quotations of 9:24, 9:25 and 10:1 are verbatim.
SUPPORTED: vision_noun_hazon_heb 9.24, year_word_but_not_a_dateline 9.25 and 9.26, and the dateline at 10.1 are in the inventory at those verses.

NOTE: the row's EXTRACTED tier for the absence of a mark names OSHB/WLC; the fact is held by the mark layer drawn from that witness, since the verse extract itself carries no paragraph marks (measured: no maqaf and no paseq character in the extract either).
